exercises.question: Which sentence states an opinion? [¿Cuál expresa una opinión?]
options: Creo que la propuesta es positiva. [I think the proposal is positive.]
La propuesta existe. [The proposal exists.]
Hay una propuesta. [There is a proposal.]

exercises.english: It seems worrying to me that the service is so expensive.

sentences: Primero, creo que la propuesta es positiva. [First, I think the proposal is positive.]
Después, considero que la medida es eficaz. [Then, I consider the measure effective.]
Finalmente, me parece preocupante que el servicio sea tan caro. [Finally, it seems worrying to me that the service is so expensive.]

exercises.question: Which expression means «I consider»? [¿Qué expresión significa «considero»?]
options: Considero que [I consider that]
Estoy de acuerdo [I agree]
Debido a [due to]

exercises.sentence: Creo que la propuesta es positiva.
options: I think the proposal is positive.
I think the proposal is impossible.
I disagree with the proposal.
Creo que la propuesta es positiva. [I think the proposal is positive.]
Creo que la propuesta sea positiva. [I think the proposal is (subjunctive) positive.]
Creo que la propuesta es positivo. [I think the proposal is positive (masculine).]
Considero que la medida es eficaz. [I consider the measure effective.]
Considero que la medida sea eficaz. [I consider that the measure is (subjunctive) effective.]
Considero de que la medida es eficaz. [I consider of that the measure is effective.]
Me parece preocupante que el servicio sea tan caro. [It seems worrying to me that the service is so expensive.]
Me parece preocupante que el servicio es tan caro. [It seems worrying to me that the service is (indicative) so expensive.]
Me parece preocupado que el servicio sea tan caro. [It seems worried to me that the service is so expensive.]

template.prompt: State and evaluate a political proposal.
template.answer: Creo que la propuesta es positiva y considero que puede ser eficaz.

template.prompt: Give an opinion and identify a concern.
template.answer: Me parece preocupante que el servicio sea tan caro, aunque la propuesta puede ser útil.
